overall_reason: A release checklist with no single structure: the title, meta, tasks and statuses all use the same 12px #777 text, and the layout switches from left-aligned to centred.

score.reason: T-SIGNATURE and T-BOLD-MOVE fail: 'Release checklist' is 12px #777 at weight 400, the same as 'Due Friday · 4 tasks', and the statuses start at x 493 and x 511.

findings.evidence: 'Release checklist', 'Due Friday · 4 tasks', 'Review copy', 'Ready', 'Test mobile' and 'In review' are all 12px, weight 400, #777. 'Test mobile' starts at x 420 while 'Review copy' starts at x 413, and 'In review' starts at x 511 while 'Ready' starts at x 493.
findings.before: Title, tasks and statuses in one style, on drifting columns
findings.after: Title at heading weight; tasks in one left column and statuses in one right column
findings.why: A checklist is read as rows and columns; without them the reader cannot scan which task is in which state.

findings.evidence: '2 tasks remaining' and 'Open project' are centred under left-aligned content, so the only loud element floats free of the list.
findings.before: Centred footer under a left-aligned card
findings.after: Align the footer with the list: count on the left, button on the right
findings.why: The one bold element should anchor the structure, not break it.

strengths: The content is right for the job: a due date, task states, a remaining count and one action.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent: no brand authority, audience or overrides were available, so the item was read as an Operate composition (CON-018).
T-RIVAL-NAME cap: the composition names no client, so every placeholder label holds under any rival; the cap at 5 was not applied and the test was used only to spot default copy.
T-IDEA-CARRIES: single composition, there is no second screen to carry the idea.
T-DELETE-PICTURE and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: no lead image and no marketing promise, except where a finding says so.
T-COVER-TEXT: no brand theme or motif to recognise.
The caption above some frames ('Considered composition' / 'Composition problem') is fixture text from the capture host and was not judged.
